title: Bayesian optimization with kernel ensembles and disagreement-based acquisition for source localization and acoustic inversion
abstract: arXiv:2609.14262v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Joint source localization and geoacoustic inversion requires optimizing an objective built from an expensive normal mode propagation model. Bayesian optimization (BO) with a Gaussian process (GP) surrogate can obtain accurate parameter estimates within a limited number of forward model evaluations, but its performance depends on the choice of kernel family. With few observations in a seven-dimensional search space, no single kernel can be expected to perform consistently well across individual inversions. To reduce this dependence, we use a weighted ensemble of GPs with different kernel families, allowing the surrogate to adapt to the observed objective without committing to one kernel in advance. The ensemble is combined with an optimum-conditioned acquisition function that determines where the expensive objective should be evaluated next. translated_title: 基于核集成与分歧采集函数的贝叶斯优化用于声源定位与地声反演
translated_abstract: 声源定位与地声反演的联合问题需要优化一个由昂贵的简正波传播模型构建的目标函数。采用高斯过程替代模型的贝叶斯优化能够在有限次数的正向模型评估内获得准确的参数估计，但其性能取决于核函数族的选择。在七维搜索空间中观测数据稀少的情况下，无法期望任何单一核函数在各个反演中都能保持一致良好的表现。为了降低这种依赖性，我们使用由不同核函数族的高斯过程组成的加权集成，使替代模型能够自适应地拟合观测到的目标函数，而无需预先确定某一种核函数。该集成与一个基于最优条件的采集函数相结合，用于确定下一步应该在何处评估这个昂贵的目标函数。在模拟数据和SWellEx-96实测数据上的实验表明，该方法达到了……
tldr: 该论文提出了一种将不同核函数族的高斯过程加权集成与基于分歧的最优条件采集函数相结合的贝叶斯优化方法，从而摆脱对单一核函数选择的依赖，在有限的正向模型评估次数内高效实现声源定位与地声反演的联合优化。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a Bayesian optimization method combining a weighted ensemble of Gaussian processes with different kernel families and a disagreement-based optimum-conditioned acquisition function, reducing dependence on kernel choice and enabling efficient joint source localization and geoacoustic inversion within limited forward model evaluations.
